seed: A piece of music picked, with nothing switched from its default. Under Sound the panel has a Fades section as the audio mock draws it: In and Out boxes side by side and a Curve dropdown, with the note about the diamonds on the lane. Typing a length into In fades the music in, and the level line on its bar rises out of silence; Out does the same at the end; the curve bends both; and each of those is one step to undo.

steps.note: The sample music is picked. The panel shows Properties, then Sound with its Level, then Fades: In 0.0s and Out 0.0s in two boxes, and Curve reading Linear, with 'drag the diamonds on the lane' beside the header

steps.reads: drag the diamonds on the lane

steps.note: 1.5 typed into In. The box reads 1.5s and the level line on the music's bar starts at the bottom and rises to the level a second and a half in, with the left diamond at the top of that rise

Ease in out picked from Curve. Both fades on the bar are now S shaped rather than straight: slow out of silence, quick through the middle, easing into the level, and the fade out the same played backwards
Three Command Zs take the curve, then the fade out, then the fade in, one each: the music is back to a flat line and both boxes read 0.0s
